t: Orca deionised water provides a pure, mineral-free solution for various cleaning and household tasks. This 5-litre supply is suitable for achieving streak-free results on windows, mirrors, and polished surfaces, making it a reliable choice for professional cleaners and tradespeople. It is also effective for use in steam cleaners to prevent limescale build-up and ensures pristine finishes when ironing, offering a chemical-free and versatile option for many applications.
